definitions.explanation: A small-scale fight or clash: between troops at a border, between protesters and police, or between rival fans. Also used for a minor quarrel or friction between people or groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a skirmish at the border.

examples.japanese: ⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A scuffle broke out between the demonstrators and the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Players from both teams got into a scuffle, and the game was briefly halted.

notes:
⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + {競|せ}り{合|あ}い (competing, jostling). A news word for incidents that stop short of real fighting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ / ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: a skirmish breaks out
- {小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: it comes to a scuffle
- ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小競|こぜ}り{合|あ}い: border skirmish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧: clash, conflict; can be large-scale
- ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧: conflict, dispute; a prolonged situation
- ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧: quarrel, fight between individuals
